premises: Thermal aging at ~400°C induces grain-boundary segregation of Mn or Cr in single-phase CoCrFeMnNi
This segregation reduces local cohesive strength at grain boundaries
Reduced cohesive strength leads to premature crack initiation and brittle behavior
Brittle behavior manifests under low-temperature or impact loading
The mechanism is distinct from coarse precipitate formation
